motion.process: ten carbon cloth plies progressively draped onto the actual shell profile

appearance.sharedMaterial: Catalogue carbon weave — fixed source coordinates
appearance.shaderPolicy: Copy the original catalogue material nodes and all their values. Replace only Generated input with an equivalent immutable source-coordinate point attribute; original shell and every ply share this same material datablock.
appearance.coordinateFormula: (source mesh-local vertex - source texspace_location) / (2 * source texspace_size) + 0.5
appearance.coordinateInterpolation: POINT FLOAT_VECTOR, barycentrically interpolated on the same retained source triangles; never recomputed by apply(progress).

motion.seatedNormals: Original source corner normals carried onto corresponding retained skin triangles.
motion.geometryPolicy: Intact supplied shell retained. Each ply derives only from unobstructed original skin triangles; no shell slicing or solid-seat duplicates.
motion.layupPolicy: One moving cloth ply at a time; a continuous contact front seats it from the pan toward the upper back. Earlier plies remain seated and future plies are hidden.
motion.clearancePolicy: All plies share a projection along one unobstructed pull direction. Positive, strictly ordered offsets keep each moving ply above the shell and all already laid plies.
motion.interpretation: User-requested ten-layer process illustration. Display spacing and cloth motion are conceptual; no measured laminate thickness, ply orientation schedule, cure cycle or material performance is claimed.

cameraTracking: Original source camera position and direction
